title: Derrick
description: The &3Oil Derrick&r extracts &bCrude Oil&r and &6&bNatural Gas&r from &eOil Deposits&r that are directly below them. When supplied with power, it will begin to drill downwards until it cannot drill further or reach an oil deposit. Upon reaching a deposit, it will continuously extract oil and gas from it until the deposit is entirely depleted.
